inputs.ell_active_i: measured active-role loss probability per site/epoch
inputs.ell_spare_i: measured spare-role loss probability per site/epoch
inputs.check_i: measured occupancy/readout failure probability per site/epoch
inputs.pair_repair_i_j: measured probability a spare at site j successfully MOVE+reset+verifies after detected active loss at site i

primary_objective: choose integer spare counts n_i>=0, sum n_i=5, maximizing minimum cumulative site survival S_i=(1-ell_active_i)^(5-n_i)(1-ell_spare_i)^n_i(1-check_i)^5
secondary_objective: among schedules realizing the primary-optimal count vector, maximize the minimum pair-repair probability encountered by active-site/spare-site combinations; then maximize their mean
claim_rule: controller proves an exact calibration-to-schedule map under the declared independent site-channel model; it is not hardware validation.
